How to verify: Transfer and verify the governing level, plumb, centerline, elevation, or wall reference at the work area.
Pass criteria: Every installed component traces to the same checked reference.

How to verify: Locate structure, services, membranes, hazards, and no-fastener zones using appropriate records and methods.
Pass criteria: Anchoring and cutting avoid unverified hidden conditions.

How to verify: Record variance, proposed correction, approval, affected parts, and updated documents before alteration.
Pass criteria: A field fix cannot silently change design, safety, function, or future service.

How to verify: Reconfirm wall width, floor and ceiling level, wall plumb, baseboard, crown, outlets, and heat sources.
Pass criteria: Cases plus fillers and scribes fit the controlling envelope.

How to verify: Set a common level and face plane while checking join lines, shelf holes, reveals, and face frames.
Pass criteria: The full elevation reads as one aligned installation.

How to verify: Plan structural attachment, removable service access, trim, caulk, touch-up, and protection.
Pass criteria: Anchors remain effective and finish work does not hide an unresolved gap.
